title: IGAR Paper 1: Weak-Label Disagreement and Transformer Supervision-Source Sensitivity — Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility materials for the study "Characterizing Weak-Label Disagreement in Indonesian Digital Public-Service Application Reviews: Transformer Sensitivity to Supervision-Source Choice". Version 1.1.0 preserves the original frozen v1.0.0 primary-analysis record and adds the separately versioned P1R-11 revision-stage reproducibility addendum. P1R-11 used preserved RQ4 predictions and metadata, added post hoc sensitivity and diagnostic analyses, and did not retrain models or alter the frozen primary RQ1–RQ4 estimates. The IGAR dataset is not redistributed and remains available from Mendeley Data, Version 3, DOI 10.17632/7zryc6k76z.3.
